**How bad was it?**

<!-- Pick one: Heliotrope closed / the page went blank / the desktop

**Your machine**

Paste the output of these commands, run in a shell:

```
uname -R
hinv
gfxinfo
```

<!-- gfxinfo is /usr/gfx/gfxinfo. -->

**Which Heliotrope**

<!-- The tardist (which version, for example 2026.11.28) or pkgsrc's
